script: Got rude guy arrested for suspended license. . I used to hang with my crew at a tiny pool hall in a neighboring town. We'd rent a table, watch sports, chat. No drama. Then one day, a guy walks in and takes our spot. Not a big deal, we were still talking. Twenty minutes later, I tell him we want the next game. He's like, "Whatever." We don't get to play the next round. Another girl wants after us. He ignores us both. We keep playing until he leaves. (I know, right?) We grab the table, drop quarters, and the green 6 ball is missing. He just walked off with our green ball. The manager says it's 12:30, last call, closing soon, so he gives us a ball instead of making a scene. He comes back from the bathroom, knows we caught him. He smirks, goes to the patio, grabs a cigarette, a beer, and the green ball. He returns, tosses that ball like a grenade, wrecks our game, and heads for the bar at last call. We're like, "We're going to call the cops." One friend says let's follow him home, call highway patrol for a suspected drunk driver. Three of us agree. We pull the Nextel push‑to‑talk, coordinate calls. We give them the license plate, make, color, say he swerved, nearly hit another car. We do it in 15 minutes. We don't know where he lives, but we suspect it's close since he was just hanging in a neighborhood spot, so we're on a tight timeline. One dude who didn't call the police tails him and, when an officer pulls him over, he's like, "Got it!" The police blotter that week had a guy arrested for driving on a suspended license. He wasn't arrested for DWI, but for the license being suspended.
